io.github.thebusybiscuit.sensibletoolbox.utils

Enum ColoredMaterial

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.lang.Enum<ColoredMaterial>
      • io.github.thebusybiscuit.sensibletoolbox.utils.ColoredMaterial
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Comparable<ColoredMaterial>

    public enum ColoredMaterial
extends java.lang.Enum<ColoredMaterial>
    This class holds a few ordered Lists that hold colored variants of Material.
